an4.276:1.1: “Bhikkhus, for direct knowledge of lust, four things are to be developed.
an4.276:1.3: (1) Here, a bhikkhu develops the basis for psychic potency that possesses concentration due to desire and activities of striving.
an4.276:1.4: (2) He develops the basis for psychic potency that possesses concentration due to energy … (3) … that possesses concentration due to mind … (4) … that possesses concentration due to investigation and activities of striving.
an4.276:1.7: For direct knowledge of lust, these four things are to be developed.”
